note: What clinical mode would require before it could be offered. It is unavailable: no item below has evidence. The 'status' field is informational only; availability is computed from the evidence and approvals by src/lib/genome/release.ts, so editing 'status' alone cannot enable clinical mode. Each item names the kind of qualified reviewer it needs; none has been appointed or consulted. Nothing here asserts that any standard or regulation applies or is satisfied.

requiredEvidence.description: A clinical intended-use statement for a defined condition, population, user and setting, approved by the project owner and a qualified clinical reviewer.
A documented determination of the regulatory status and pathway for that intended use, by a qualified regulatory reviewer. No pathway has been chosen.
Legal sign-off that every data source and component used in the clinical path may be used for that purpose, recorded in config/genome/licences.json as clinicalUse: approved.
An approved analytical validation protocol, dataset description, metrics, acceptance criteria and results for the clinical function.
Clinical validation evidence for the intended use, with its protocol and acceptance criteria, approved by a qualified clinical reviewer.
A release review under a documented quality and change-control process, with traceability from requirements to verified tests.
